metadata.title: Clicked like a confused potato and somehow stole 1 kill? Valorant’s aim went on vacation!
metadata.description:
Me: button mashing like it’s a bug hunt
Enemy: probably reconsidering life choices
Valorant just gave me a kill for the chaos
Click if your aim is gloriously broken too!

Smash like if your kills are just as accidental!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
